title: Exterior Occurrence Scope for Recalls and Continued Failures, Utility Line Protection Plans
content:
# Exterior Occurrence Scope for Recalls and Continued Failures

Claims desk adjudication note, Bridgewell Utility Line Protection Plans, exterior service lines.

## Rule

The exterior occurrence benefit left open is worked out over the exterior occurrence scope. Exterior occurrence scope: for a recall reported no later than the plan's repair guarantee days after the most recent completed repair on the same line, the amounts already authorized, net of reversals, on the request of that completed repair are deducted from the line's occurrence cap together with those on the service request; for a new failure reported no more than the exterior continuation days after a temporary repair was authorized on another request for the same line, the amounts already authorized, net of reversals, on that temporary-repair request are deducted together with those on the service request; for every other request only the amounts on the service request are deducted.

## Figures

- Repair guarantee: 180 calendar days on every Utility Line Protection Plan.
- Exterior continuation days: 14 calendar days.

## Which requests' net amounts come off the cap

| Service request | Requests whose net amounts are deducted |
|---|---|
| recall reported on or before day 180 after the most recent completed repair on the same line | the completed repair's request and the service request |
| new failure reported on or before day 14 after a temporary repair was authorized on another request for the same line | that temporary-repair request and the service request |
| any other | the service request only |

## Boundary cases

Recall on day 180: joined; day 181: not joined. New failure on day 14 after the temporary repair was authorized: joined; day 15: not joined.

## Hypothetical example

Sewer line occurrence cap $10000.00; new failure placed 6 days after a temporary repair was authorized on another request for the same lateral; $700.00 net on that request and $1300.00 net on this one: $2000.00 is deducted, leaving $8000.00 open.
